question: §3 — does more independent-test-guided repair (maxRepair 1 -> 3) fix the hard native-execution failures?
completed: 6 of 9 missions (run slow; 2 attempts/type recorded at maxRepair=3, vs 2/type at maxRepair=1)
finding: More guided repair fixes the MEDIUM-hard class: lru 0/2 -> 2/2, infix 0/2 -> 1/2 (the independent-test-failure hint 'builds but fails the test — fix the logic' drives convergence). But topo (cycle-detecting topological sort) remains 0/2 even at maxRepair=3 — it needs DECOMPOSITION, not just more retries. Combined §3 picture: borderline tasks ← model size; medium-hard ← repair depth; hardest (topo) ← decomposition. No failure reclassified as success; `verified` is the independent verifier's verdict.
